findings.title: Async effect sets state after unmount with no cancellation
findings.why_it_matters: If the screen unmounts, or tenantId changes, before the fetch resolves, setTotals runs on an unmounted component and a stale response can overwrite a newer one. Unlike the subscription effect above it, this one returns no cleanup.
findings.suggested_fix: Track a cancelled flag in the effect cleanup, or pass an AbortSignal to fetchOrderTotals.
